summary: <cite index="7-10,7-11">The S&P 500 rose on Friday as traders interpreted an unexpected loss of jobs in July as meaning the Federal Reserve won't need to raise interest rates soon</cite>, with <cite index="7-11,7-12">the broad market index advancing 0.62% for a record close of 7,757.64, while the Nasdaq Composite climbed 1.3% to 26,690.62</cite>. <cite index="45-14,45-15">Economists surveyed by Bloomberg had expected to see 80,000 new jobs created in July, but instead, 23,000 jobs were lost and the unemployment rate ticked down to 4.1%</cite>. <cite index="7-17">Markets reacted to the report by taking a September rate hike off the table</cite>. The dovish repricing came just over a week after <cite index="10-2,10-3">the FOMC voted 9-3 to keep rates steady, with regional presidents Beth Hammack, Neel Kashkari, and Lorie Logan dissenting in favor of a hike</cite>. On the earnings front, <cite index="7-4">Atlassian shares surged more than 29% in premarket after beating FactSet consensus on revenue and earnings</cite>, while <cite index="7-6,7-7">Wendy's dropped 2% after global sales decreased by more than 6% and the company withdrew its 2026 financial outlook</cite>. <cite index="45-13,47-3">Bitcoin and ethereum prices responded positively to the weak jobs report, with both firming up as cooler labor data tends to support risk assets</cite>.

signals.title: July jobs report shocks with 23K job losses, killing rate-hike bets
signals.desc: Unexpected job losses sparked a rally in stocks and crypto as markets priced out a September Fed hike, reducing monetary tightening risk.

signals.title: Fed hawks emerge: 3-member dissent strongest since 2016
signals.desc: Three regional Fed presidents voted for a hike at July's FOMC meeting, signaling hawkish resistance and inflation concerns persist.

signals.title: Atlassian crushes earnings, stock surges 29% premarket
signals.desc: Strong Q4 revenue and earnings beat lifted the software name sharply higher, though full-year guidance was slightly below estimates.

signals.title: Crypto holds $65K/$1,910 as weak jobs data eases Fed pressure
signals.desc: Bitcoin and Ethereum firmed modestly after the jobs miss cooled rate-hike odds, but geopolitical and legislative headwinds limit upside momentum.

signals.title: Wendy's withdraws 2026 outlook as U.S. sales plunge 8.2%
signals.desc: Restaurant chain pulled guidance and posted sharp sales declines despite beating earnings, signaling weak consumer demand in quick-service.

verdict: Risk assets are rallying on dovish repricing after the shockingly weak July jobs report, but hawkish Fed dissents and lingering geopolitical tensions keep volatility elevated.
